description: Step 2 of a Watch: the owner-signed message from watch_prepare. Free inside the manager's paid period or during the beta; otherwise one period costs the `priceUsdc` watch_terms returns, paid by x402. Without payment the result is an error whose structuredContent is the x402 PaymentRequired: an x402 MCP client retries with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]; any other client POSTs `payBody` to `payUrl` and pays its HTTP 402 with an x402 wallet. `extend: true` buys one more period now. Returns the watch and a Telegram link for the owner.

chainId.description: The manager's chain (the typed data domain's chainId)

extend.description: Pay for one more period even inside a paid one

signature.description: The owner's EIP-712 signature over that typed data

name: watch_subscribe
title: Watcher: start or update a watch (may be paid)
